description: This file contains the definition of the Gdpr controller class for email-related GDPR operations within the OpenCart catalog module. It includes methods for handling GDPR email notifications and GDPR data removal requests.

classes.name: Gdpr
classes.description: Controller class for GDPR email notifications and data removal management within the OpenCart catalog module.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles GDPR email notifications, constructing and sending emails based on provided route, arguments, and output.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Handles GDPR data removal requests, updating GDPR status and notifying the customer via email.
